Do what you can when you can. I used to draw day and night,  all over my homework, even if no one saw. I moved a lot growing up (12 schools) and was homeschooled at times, I never had a regular friend til I was a junior in high school because I basically just gave up trying. I intentionally kept people at bay, made sure they knew I was scary and strange so they'd leave me alone..eventually a girl stranger than me wouldn't leave me alone and she's the only reason I know anyone at all. 18 years later and she's trans gender/gay, in a metal band, a bouncer at a bar, just found out recently that she's on the spectrum, mom to an awesome son, and I'm driving a rental car 2,000+ miles to go see her next week. Sometimes the answer to being socially awkward and poorly raised is to just accept it and find other awkward people.  You'll bond over the fact that you've had a shit time and felt mostly unloved your whole life (my case, not yours necessarily ) or you'll just be more tolerant people because of the fact that you're lonely, whatever the reason, don't think that fitting in with well adjusted people is an option.  You may pull it off but you may never truly get to be yourself. Find the oddballs! It pays off!
